lens: Geometry and proportion first, then colour, materials and artefacts. Candidate renders: S/r49 (q15-q17) and S/s49 (studio). Before: S/r0 and S/s0 (2bd3366, w48 geometry). I read the bc67a43 diff of 09a_econ.js. The w48 scripts were gone, so I rewrote them in S/raterB49. crop.py makes render | photo | before triptychs: cover17.png, arm17.png, pocket17.png, pocketz.png, q15c.png and q15far.png. cov.py segments the near-right q17 cover (low-saturation blob nearest (700,215)) and writes covmasks.png. q15.py plus inline column and row profiles measure the head-on cover. arm.py gives the white runs under the aisle arm at x 500-690. Inline box stats measure the pouch. The q17 blend is q17_econBacks_blend.png / blendnear.png, and st_*.png are the studio before/after pairs.
calibrationNote: Two of the three w48 mediums are visibly fixed. Aisle-end arm: the lower member is now one J moulding with a 30 px gap and a low bar at the photo's height. Pocket: a light-grey pouch with the card header and black-rimmed side mesh replaces the dark grille. The headrest cover is bigger in q17 (blob area 3671 -> 4646 px) but has not moved toward the photo. Its bottom is still ~47 px high, and it reads as a sheared parallelogram lying back rather than a convex drape. Lowering its foot by 1 cm cost the head-on view: the q15 cover h/w went from 0.84 to 0.92 (y_47300 ~0.77), and the foot is now 26 px below the photo's. That is the old w25/w35 complaint come back. The two views disagree in a consistent way. In q15 the photo cover sits closer to the back top than ours; in q17 it sits further below it. So the photo's cushion and cover stand further forward of the back, which an elevated camera shows as lower, rather than hanging lower. A taller cover therefore cannot satisfy both views. I also correct my w48b-1 wording: y_47303 does show ~25-30 px of back fabric above the cover fold (back top ~152, fold ~180). Ours shows ~10 px. The flap does not wrap the top edge. Detail mean 8.52 (w48 8.50). Overall 8.65: +0.05 because the arm and pocket fixes clearly show at q17 size, held back by the q15 cover regression and the unchanged q17 cover placement.

issues.owner: econ (09a_econ.js headrest cover CPL drape and hem)
issues.title: Regression: the head-on q15 cover is too tall again (h/w 0.92 vs ~0.77), with its foot 26 px below y_47300's
issues.evidence: q15 column profiles at x 388 and 543: the render cover plus hem runs 252-319 (w48 255-~315), against 241-~294 in the photo. The width is 73 against ~71. h/w is 0.92 (w48 0.84, photo ~0.77). The CPL foot moved from y 0.625 to 0.615 and the hem with it. This is the w25/w35 head-on complaint come back (q15c.png).
issues.fix: In econSeat, raise the CPL foot back up to y ~0.645-0.65, dropping the first one or two CPL points and starting at [0.648, z]. Move the hem band, rolled-foot tube, stitch and ANA mark with it: they use cz() and the literal ys 0.617/0.636/0.6365/0.6385, so shift those by the same +0.03. Keep the fold at 0.825 or raise it ~1 cm with the strip, to close the 11 px top offset. Do not lengthen the cover to chase q17: see w49b-2.
issues.check: In q15 at x 388 and 543, the cover plus hem height is <= 58 px (h/w 0.74-0.82), the foot is within 8 px of y 294, and the width stays 70-75 px.

issues.title: q17 cover still 34-47 px high and lying back: in y_47303 the cushion and cover stand further forward of the back top
issues.evidence: cov.py: render 640-754 x 148-236 (115 x 89) against photo 668-753 x 182-283+ (86 x >= 102). w48 was 153-238, so the placement did not move. The cover sits ~10 px below the back top here against ~25-30 px in the photo. In q15 it is the other way round: the photo cover sits closer to the back top than ours (top 241 vs 252). With the camera above the head and in front of the seat, that pattern means the photo's cover face is further forward (toward the camera, -z) and more upright, not lower. Our plate is a sheared parallelogram with flat tone, while the photo shows a convex drape with a lit-to-shade gradient (cover17.png, blendnear.png).
issues.fix: Bring the centre cushion loft and CPL forward ~3 cm (z -0.03) over y 0.65-0.80, with the fold section and strip following. Make the drape more upright: the z difference between foot and fold is now 0.05 over 0.19 m, so cut it to ~0.025. Give the CPL mid points ~1 cm of extra forward bow, so the shading shows a convex drape. Move the wing bolsters forward with the cushion so they don't swallow it. Keep the head-on width at 0.22.
issues.check: q17 near cover blob height >= 100 px and taller than wide, bottom within 20 px of y 283, top 22-35 px below the near back top; the q15 w49b-1 check still holds.

issues.evidence: Pouch box: L81, B/R 1.32, std 33, against the photo's L97, B/R 1.58, std 62. y_47303 shows a cool, satin grey-blue nylon pouch with bright fold highlights bulging at the foot, and mesh panels about half the pouch's width at each side. issues.fix: Pouch material: #9298a1, r 0.85 -> ~#98a2b5, r ~0.55, so it picks up a sheen. Add 2-3 shallow vertical crease bands (darker lofts 1 cm wide) and raise the bul() amplitude 0.034 -> 0.045 at the foot. Widen the side mesh panels 0.066 -> ~0.085, moving cx to ~0.13 if the shell allows. Raise the card 1 cm so more white body shows above the hem.
